app.name: Interview Coach
app.practiceOnly: Practice only: this app is for rehearsal, never for help during a real interview.
app.noAccount: No account. Nothing leaves this computer unless you choose an engine that says so.

server.title: The app server isn't answering
server.body: Interview Coach runs a small server on this computer. Start it, then check again.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the session was deleted.

engines.title: AI engine
engines.subtitle: Mike needs an AI model to think. Free and local by default: no key, no account.
engines.testOk: It works. The model replied in {ms} ms.
engines.recheckNote: We check again every 5 seconds while this page is open.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.tagline: Runs the AI model on this computer.
ollama.notInstalled: Ollama isn't installed on this computer.
ollama.afterInstall: Install it, open it once, then come back and press Check again.
ollama.notRunning: Ollama is installed but not running, so Mike can't think yet.
ollama.noModel: Ollama is running, but the model isn't downloaded yet.
ollama.pullHint: Paste this into Terminal. The download is about 2.5 GB.
ollama.voiceModelHint: Mike answers faster with {model}. A larger model gives better follow-ups but takes about 3–4 s to reply.

openai.name: Other AI (OpenAI-compatible)
openai.tagline: LM Studio, Jan, OpenRouter, OpenAI or any server that speaks the OpenAI API.
openai.apiKeyHint: Stored only on this computer. Local servers usually don't need one.
openai.apiKeySet: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
openai.modelHint: The exact model name your server lists, for example qwen3-4b-instruct.
openai.paidNote: Online providers may charge for use. Check their pricing before you practise.

claude.name: Claude Code CLI
claude.tagline: Uses the Claude Code app you already have, signed in with your own account.
claude.detected: Claude Code was found on this computer.
claude.notFound: Claude Code wasn't found on this computer.

gemini.name: Gemini Live
gemini.tagline: Google's live voice model, with your own free API key.
gemini.apiKeyHint: Create a free key in Google AI Studio. Stored only on this computer.

engine.title: Choose how Mike runs
engine.subtitle: Free and local by default. No key, no account.

test.title: Let's check everything works
test.subtitle: A quick check of your microphone, the AI model and Mike's voice.
test.micPrompt: Your browser will ask to use the microphone. Choose "Allow".
test.micSay: Say: "I'm preparing for an interview next week."
test.micQuiet: Speak a little louder or closer to the microphone.
test.micDenied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser's address bar, or use the keyboard instead.
test.micMissing: No microphone found. Connect one, or use the keyboard instead.
test.voiceMissing: Mike's voice isn't installed. You'll read his questions instead.
test.speechMissing: Not installed. You can still answer with the keyboard.
test.telemetry: Share anonymous usage counts to help improve the app
test.telemetryHint: Counts, timings, engine names and error codes. Never what you said or wrote. Off by default, and today nothing leaves this computer.

about.title: About you and the job
about.subtitle: Both are optional. With them, Mike asks about your own experience and the role you want.
about.cv: Your CV or a short summary
about.cvPlaceholder: Paste your CV, or a few lines about your experience.

first.title: Your first round
first.subtitle: Five questions, about 20 minutes. Feedback appears after each question, never while you're talking.

vacancies.title: Which interview are you preparing for?
vacancies.empty: Add the job you're preparing for: Mike will ask about this role and its requirements.
vacancies.generalHint: Common interview questions for any role.
vacancies.addCv: Add your CV so questions use your own experience.

round.title: Round
round.behaviouralHint: Stories from your work: what you did and what changed.
round.mixHint: A bit of both, like most first interviews.
round.gentleHint: At most one follow-up per question.
round.standardHint: A follow-up when an answer misses your role, a result or a reflection.
round.toughHint: Up to two follow-ups, and Mike asks for numbers.
round.basisJob: Questions from your CV, the {job} job and the general question bank.
round.basisJobNoCv: Questions from the {job} job and the general question bank.
round.basisCv: Questions from your CV and the general question bank.

example.title: Example: what you get after each question
example.label: Example
example.content: Missing result: end with what changed.
example.delivery: 14 fillers · 2:50 · 132 wpm: shorter answers land better
example.after: Weak spots appear here after your first interview.

english.levelHint: You can change it any time.
english.notSure: Not sure? Pick B1 if you can talk about familiar things but often search for words.
english.after: After each of your turns you'll see up to 3 corrections with a reason. Nothing appears while you speak.
english.free: Free forever: no limits on English practice.

vacancy.title: Add a job
vacancy.textShort: Paste a little more: at least a few sentences ({n} of 80 characters).
vacancy.urlHint: Some pages need a login. If it doesn't work, paste the text instead.
vacancy.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD or HTML.
vacancy.jobTitleHint: For example: Kestrel Pay · Senior Product Designer. Leave empty to use the first line.

session.title: Interview session
session.voiceNeedsNew: Voice needs a new session: this one started in text mode.

orb.yourTurnVoice: Your turn. Answer when you're ready

session.heard: What we heard. A wrong word? Fix it after you answer.

firstTime.title: First time here
firstTime.voice1: Answer aloud when Mike stops. Pause to think: he waits.
firstTime.voice2: When you're done, stop talking or press Enter.
firstTime.voice3: Subtitles show what we heard. You can fix a wrong word after you answer.
firstTime.text1: Type your answer in the box below.
firstTime.text2: When you're done, press Send (Enter). Shift+Enter adds a new line.
firstTime.text3: Feedback appears on the right after each question.

controls.label: Session controls
controls.pauseHelp: Pause to think: your answer is sent after {sec} s of quiet.
controls.manualHelp: Your answer is sent when you press Send now (Enter).

input.label: Your answer
input.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

suggest.title: Sample answer
suggest.practiceOnly: Practice only. Say it in your own words.

closing.title: That's the end of the round
closing.body: Mike has finished. Your debrief takes a few seconds.

session.notSaved: Nothing was saved: you didn't answer any questions.

notice.notHeard: I didn't catch that. Please try again a little louder or closer to the microphone.
notice.mutedSpeech: You're talking, but the microphone is muted. Press M to unmute.

mic.not_allowed: The microphone is blocked, so we switched to the keyboard. Allow the microphone in the browser's address bar to use voice.
mic.not_found: No microphone found, so we switched to the keyboard.
mic.insecure: Voice needs the app to be opened from localhost. We switched to the keyboard.
mic.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. We switched to the keyboard.
mic.failed: The microphone didn't start, so we switched to the keyboard.
mic.stt_unsupported: This browser can't recognise speech. Use Chrome or Edge, or the keyboard.
mic.stt_denied: The browser blocked speech recognition, so we switched to the keyboard.

errors.title: The session stopped
errors.connection_lost: The connection to Mike was lost. Any answers you gave are saved.
errors.session_failed: Something went wrong and the session stopped. Your answers so far are saved.
errors.backlog: The connection can't keep up with the audio. Ending the session and saving it.
errors.engineTitle: Mike can't start: the AI engine isn't ready

session.missing: This session wasn't started from Practice.

feedback.p0: Feedback appears here after each question: one fix for content, language and delivery. Nothing will pop up while you're talking.
feedback.p0English: Corrections appear here after each of your turns. Nothing will pop up while you're talking.
feedback.p1: Listening. Feedback comes after your answer.
feedback.p4: Feedback isn't available for this answer. Your answer is saved.
feedback.question: Question {n}
feedback.showAnswer: Show your answer as we heard it

content.nothing: Nothing to fix in this answer.

language.nothing: Nothing to fix in this answer.
language.misheard: We may have misheard some words. If a quote isn't what you said, tell us: it won't count.
language.removed: Removed: we won't flag this again in this session.
language.removedMisheard: You marked "{text}" as misheard: not counted.

delivery.textMode: Pace and fillers aren't available in text mode.

stronger.title: A stronger answer
stronger.placeholders: Fill in the parts in brackets with your real details.
stronger.unavailable: Couldn't write a stronger answer this time.

debrief.title: Debrief
debrief.pending: Writing your debrief. This takes a few seconds…
debrief.tooShort: This round was short, so the debrief is brief. Answer at least 3 questions for a full one.
debrief.template: The AI model wasn't available, so this debrief was built from your feedback without it.
debrief.noFeedback: No feedback was recorded for this session.
debrief.notFound: This session wasn't found. It may have been deleted.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every practice round, saved on this computer.
history.emptyBody: Your first practice round will show up here with its debrief.

voice.title: Mike's voice
voice.unavailable: Mike's voice isn't installed. He'll show his questions as text.
voice.speakHint: Off: Mike only writes. Useful in a quiet office.
voice.sttServerHint: Local recognition ({backend}). Audio stays on this computer.
voice.sttServerMissing: Local recognition isn't installed. Use the browser or the keyboard.
voice.sttBrowserHint: Uses the browser's speech recognition (Chrome, Edge). The browser may send audio to its own service.
voice.sttBrowserUnsupported: This browser has no speech recognition.
voice.pauseHint: Longer pauses give you more time to think.

practice.title: Practice
practice.suggesterHint: Practice only. Adds a "Show a sample answer" switch to interview sessions.
practice.layerOrderHint: The order of the three feedback blocks after each question.

profile.title: Your CV
profile.hint: Mike uses it to ask about your own experience. It stays on this computer.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.telemetryHint: Off by default. Counts, timings, engine names and error codes, never what you said or wrote. Today nothing leaves this computer.
privacy.folderHint: Sessions, your CV and settings are saved here as plain files.
privacy.obsidianHint: Optional. Each finished session is also saved as a Markdown note in this folder.

errors.server_unreachable: The app server is not answering.
